question: Panel the Schedule I PurposeOfGrantTxt field for the top 50 DAF sponsors (latest return in the GivingTuesday lake): count distinct purpose strings per sponsor, share of boilerplate, and whether any sponsor codes purpose by a taxonomy (Schwab uses about 10 sector labels). Test whether public 990 data can support grant-purpose analytics at all
conclusion_affected: Whether an AI-native entrant can build recipient or purpose analytics from public 990 data or must buy licensed data (Candid)
rationale: Three sampled returns: JCF FY2025 and Vanguard FY2024 each carry one boilerplate purpose across 4,976 and 24,269 rows; Schwab FY2023 carries 10 sector labels across 48,202 rows

question: Document how each top-10 sponsor's electronic grant carries remittance data: ACH SEC code (CCD/CCD+/CTX), whether a grant ID or fund name sits in the addenda, and what arrives out-of-band (email report, dashboard, CSV). Use public nonprofit-facing EFT pages, enrolment forms and Chariot's sponsor list only; no enrolment or test payments
conclusion_affected: Size of the reconciliation problem a remittance standard or a cross-sponsor matching API (entry option S2) would solve
rationale: Fidelity's EFT page says ACH grant details are 'Sent with grant notice' (emailed daily) and Stripe grants sit in a dashboard; Chariot requires its ID on the 'grant letter / remittance advice'. No sponsor was found that documents a grant ID in ACH addenda

question: Map the DAF-relevant contents of a US grant-data schema: compare the Chariot DAFpay sponsor spec, Endaoment's async-grant OpenAPI, 360Giving 1.4 and the federal Grants Data Standards v3.0 field by field. Draft a minimal open DAF grant record (grant ID, fund ID, recipient EIN, amount, purpose code, anonymity, status, payment reference) and list which fields Form 990 already requires
conclusion_affected: Whether an AI-native entrant should publish an open grant-request and remittance spec as a wedge, and what it would cost others to adopt
rationale: No open multi-sponsor DAF grant spec was found. DAF Direct publishes no API; Chariot's spec is vendor-certified and says it does not require an exact specification; Endaoment and Chariot already share idempotency, fund, amount, purpose and anonymity fields
